The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (August 11, 2020) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Ariba Doc. Number 2439984369 (Tender 114-2020) Description: For the supply and delivery of all materials, labour, equipment, and supervision required to perform roof replacement to the Burrows Hall Community Centre and Library on behalf of the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division of the City of Toronto. Recommended Supplier: Triumph Roofing and Sheet Metal Inc. Contract Award Value: $ 644,200 net of all applicable taxes and charges $ 727,946 including HST and all applicable charges $ 655,538 net of HST recoveries The contract is expected to start in October 2020 and end by December 31, 2020.
